title: The Four Rain Celestial Swords
summary: The birth of the Rain Celestial Swords draws two powerful outsiders: Tian Mozi of Planet Tianmo and Ling Tianhou, the Sword Saint of the Da Lou Sword Sect. Sun Tai bluffs about a fourth soul hidden in Zhou Yi's coffin, but Wang Lin calls it a remnant soul and lets him live. Chi Hu's Star Compass is broken, so Wang Lin repairs it, and Chi Hu gives it to him in friendship. The awakened Celestial, who says her name is not really Ting'er, calls out the second and third swords and fights Ling Tianhou and his Scarlet Qilin, breaking his two swords with one finger even though her life force is fading. All-Seer appears, Tian Mozi takes one sword and leaves, and the Celestial's remnant soul thanks Zhou Yi, saying she was born from his obsession, before the fourth sword appears.
events: Tian Mozi and Ling Tianhou sense the Rain Celestial Swords
Sun Tai's 'fourth soul' threat is exposed as a remnant soul
Wang Lin repairs the Star Compass and Chi Hu gives it to him
The Celestial summons the second and third swords
She overpowers Ling Tianhou and his Scarlet Qilin
All-Seer appears; Tian Mozi takes one sword
The Celestial's remnant soul says goodbye to Zhou Yi; the fourth sword appears
cultivation: Tian Mozi is mid Nirvana Cleanser; Ling Tianhou is late Nirvana Cleanser.
